- No file changes detected in this release.

Version 2.0.0 summary: Major update for flexible crypto price monitoring and alerting.

- Now supports real-time monitoring and customizable price alerts for BTC/ETH/SOL and meme coins.
- Market daily reports and on-chain data summaries added for comprehensive insights.
- Easy setup for price breakthrough/fall alerts with clear output and alert confirmation.
- Prioritizes Binance for price data, with automatic fallback to other sources when needed.
- Strong constraints: monitoring only (no trading), and alerts checked at defined intervals.
- All information is for reference only; no investment advice provided.
